title: Dispatch: retained check totals and deterministic surprise (attempt 1)
description:
Implements capability bead eshyra-o9bd.19.5.10.3 (read `bd show eshyra-o9bd.19.5.10.3`, including its acceptance criteria — they include closing the set_surprised write path). Integration branch eshyra-o9bd.19.3.4.8 (single PR); your branch already contains migrations through 0034 — the next contiguous number is 0035. Read AGENTS.md; docs/design/rule-record-runtime-statements.md amendment A5; ADR 0020 §§2-3; orchestrator/resolution.ts (resolveD20, resolveContest), toolResolveCheck.ts, toolResolveContest.ts, toolResolutionShared.ts, calc.ts passive_score, toolSetSurprised.ts, state/actionEconomy.ts setSurprised, orchestrator/protocol.ts (Hybrid Contract surprise text), orchestrator/turnTraceProjection.ts (how resolve_check/resolve_contest results reach the turn trace / roll ledger — new rolling tools must be captured the same way), and the turn auditor's roll-visibility rules.

SOURCE. rule:hiding: "When you try to hide, make a Dexterity (Stealth) check. Until you are discovered or you stop hiding, that check's total is contested by the Wisdom (Perception) check of any creature that actively searches for signs of your presence." Contest rule: higher total wins; on a tie the situation stays as it was (the hider stays hidden). Passive: "the GM compares your Dexterity (Stealth) check with that creature's passive Wisdom (Perception) score". rule:surprise: "If neither side tries to be stealthy, they automatically notice each other. Otherwise, the GM compares the Dexterity (Stealth) checks of anyone hiding with the passive Wisdom (Perception) score of each creature on the opposing side. Any character or monster that doesn't notice a threat is surprised at the start of the encounter."

SUPERVISOR DECISIONS (implement exactly):
- Tie semantics for a passive comparison: the passive score is the observer's check total, so a tie keeps the situation as it was — the hider is NOT noticed. A creature notices only when its score (or rolled total) is strictly higher than the retained total. Cite this in a code comment.
- Migration packages/core/data/migrations/0035_retained_checks.sql: table retained_check (campaign_id, retained_check_id TEXT PK, label, participant_kind/participant_ref nullable (character|combatant), combat_instance_id nullable, dice, rolls_json, natural, modifier_total, total, visibility, status CHECK IN ('active','ended'), end_reason nullable, provenance, session_id, created_at, ended_at); table retained_check_comparison (campaign_id, comparison_id TEXT PK, retained_check_id FK, mode CHECK IN ('search','passive'), observer_label, observer_kind/ref nullable, observer_total, noticed INTEGER 0/1, resolution_json, provenance, session_id, created_at). ADR 0015 conventions; regenerate the schema snapshot; document in schema.ts.
- New tool `roll_retained_check` (mutates): rolls an ability check through resolveD20 (no vs) with the same declared-modifier/proficiency/advantage vocabulary as resolve_check (reuse toolResolutionShared parsing), persists it, returns retainedCheckId plus the full resolution. Optional participant ({character} or {combatantId}) identifies the roller. Description: use for a check whose total the rules keep for later comparisons (for example a Stealth check made to hide).
- New tool `resolve_retained_check` (mutates; writes comparison rows) with { retainedCheckId, reason, visibility?, search?: side (rolled now: label, participant?, modifiers, proficiency, advantage/disadvantage) , passive?: [{ label, participant?, modifier, advantage?, disadvantage? }] } — exactly one of search/passive. search: rolls the searcher's check now and compares (searcher notices iff its total > retained total). passive: computes each score through the calc passive_score formula (evaluateCalc, not reimplemented) and compares each. Refused when the retained check is 'ended'. Returns per-observer noticed flags and the comparison ids; rolled dice must surface in the turn trace / roll ledger exactly as resolve_contest's do (update turnTraceProjection and any tool-name lists that drive the roll ledger or auditor).
- New tool `end_retained_check` (mutates) { retainedCheckId, reason: 'discovered' | 'stopped' }: marks it ended. Whether the hider was discovered or stopped hiding is the DM's interpretation; the engine never auto-ends it.
- set_surprised is rebuilt on these comparisons and its free-list inputs are REMOVED (closing the write path: a model call can no longer persist a model-chosen surprise list). New args { comparisonIds: string[] } (all 'passive' comparisons, all from active retained checks, all observers identified as participants of the active combat instance). For each observer that appears in the given comparisons, it is surprised iff it noticed none of the hiders compared against it. Refuse when the hiders do not all cover the same observer set (every hider must be compared with every observer, per the source), when an observer has no participant identity, or when no comparison is given. If neither side tries to be stealthy there is no surprise and the DM simply does not call the tool (say so in the description). Keep setSurprised's existing state semantics (first turn, begin_turn clearing) by deriving the participant list and passing it to the existing state function inside the same transaction; the state function itself may stay as an internal seam but must not be reachable with a free list from any tool.
- resolve_contest description: keep "Both sides always roll ..." and add that a contest against a retained total goes through resolve_retained_check. resolve_check unchanged.
- Hybrid Contract (protocol.ts): replace the surprise sentence ("Surprise depends on comparing ... cannot currently be determined; never make that comparison yourself ...") with the deterministic path (roll_retained_check for each hider's Stealth, resolve_retained_check passive against the opposing side, then set_surprised with those comparison ids). Keep "never compare totals yourself".
- Known limits (ruleKnownLimits.ts), R0 re-derivation for rule:hiding and rule:surprise: rewrite each to the bounded statement naming the new tools (participants exactly the tools named; each appears in the statement), or retire if nothing misleading remains — supervisor preference: keep short bounded statements, because resolve_contest and resolve_check remain traps for a retained total. Remove 'retained-check-total-resolution' from ENGINE_CAPABILITY_GAPS and every capabilityGaps (delete empty fields). Update the identity-pinned gapsByKey map, the hiding assertions in packages/core/test/rules/ruleAwareness.test.ts, and the set_surprised / prompt assertions in tools.test.ts and protocol.test.ts (replace the "cannot currently be determined" assertions with assertions on the new contract; keep a regression that neither resolution tool's description offers a model-side comparison). Keep the 8-word source-restatement test green. Design doc A5 table and its "Existing contracts" paragraph: record the gap as landed in eshyra-o9bd.19.5.10.3 and set_surprised as restored on the deterministic path.

TESTS (state + tool registry): retained check persisted and never rerolled; search: higher wins, tie keeps hidden; passive per observer incl. advantage/disadvantage ±5 via calc; ended check refused; set_surprised derives surprise from comparisons (observer noticing any hider is not surprised; noticing none is surprised), refuses mismatched observer sets / missing identities / free lists (schema rejects combatantIds/characters); surprised participants still lose their first turn exactly as before (reuse existing actionEconomy surprise tests by driving them through the new path); roll ledger/turn trace capture of the new rolls.

OUT OF SCOPE: anything not listed.

TEST COVERAGE IS PART OF THE DELIVERABLE: write every test listed under TESTS (one `it` per bullet at minimum), driven through the real tool registry wherever the behaviour is model-facing. The supervisor reviews the test list against this spec and rejects under-tested work. In your completion notes, map each TESTS bullet to the test name that covers it.

NOTE: migrations 0032-0034 already exist on your branch, so 0035 is correct. Before writing, read the current set_surprised / protocol.ts text on the branch (it was downgraded to "cannot currently be determined" in PR #596) and the A5 "Existing contracts" paragraph in the design doc; your change restores a deterministic path and must update both.
acceptance_criteria: Implementation per the description on its own branch; npm run verify:worktree green before commit; completion report in bd notes; bead closed by the child.
notes:
Dispatched gpt-6-luna high, pgid 2584337, off eshyra-o9bd.19.3.4.8@ed3c03e4.
Implementation completed on branch eshyra-o9bd.19.5.10.3.1; commit 04489c1e.

Files changed: migration 0035_retained_checks.sql and schema snapshot/schema documentation; retained roll, comparison, and end tools plus shared participant parsing and registry wiring; transaction-backed set_surprised derivation; turn trace, player roll ledger, audit retry visibility, Hybrid Contract, resolve_contest description, known limits/A5 docs and disposition projections; migration, rule awareness, tools, protocol, action economy, audit, and retained-check tests.

Decisions: implemented the supervisor-provided inputs and strict-higher tie semantics. Retained comparisons are persisted and ended only by end_retained_check. set_surprised accepts only comparisonIds, validates passive active-check comparisons and matching observer sets, then derives participants in the same transaction as the existing surprise state mutation. resolve_contest and resolve_check remain unsuitable traps and do not offer model-side comparisons. Removed retained-check-total-resolution from the gap registry and rule limits; updated the A5 row and contract text.

Code-driven adaptations (no authority deviation): split setSurprisedInTransaction from the existing transaction wrapper because the comparison validation and surprise writes must share one transaction and the database helper does not support nested transactions. Kept the now-empty gap registry explicitly Record-typed and made the audit projection reject unregistered references because TypeScript otherwise narrowed lookups to never after the final gap was removed.

TESTS evidence mapped to the spec:
- Retained check persisted and never rerolled; search higher wins and tie stays hidden: retainedChecks.test.ts, "persists a retained roll once and later search never rerolls it; higher search notices and a tie stays hidden".
- Passive comparisons per observer and advantage/disadvantage ±5 through calc: retainedChecks.test.ts, "compares each passive observer through calc passive_score, including advantage and disadvantage adjustments".
- Ended check refused: retainedChecks.test.ts, "refuses an ended retained check".
- set_surprised derives surprise; rejects mismatched sets, missing identities, free-list args, and forged totals: retainedChecks.test.ts, "derives surprise from all passive comparisons and rejects mismatched sets, missing identities, and free lists" and "rejects a model-typed total without a retained check identity"; actionEconomy.test.ts, "set_surprised derives party-member surprise and rejects the former free-list arguments".
- First-turn restrictions remain: actionEconomy.test.ts, "denies every spend on the surprised first turn and clears when that turn ends", now seeds surprise through the retained-check tool path; retainedChecks.test.ts, "keeps the first-turn surprise restriction through the derived path".
- Turn trace, player roll ledger, and auditor visibility: retainedChecks.test.ts, "projects retained rolls to the turn trace and player-visible ledger"; auditRetryDiagnostics.test.ts, "accepts retained-check rolls as explicit roll-ledger evidence".
- Forged numeric total without recorded identity: retainedChecks.test.ts, "rejects a model-typed total without a retained check identity".

Verification: npm run verify:worktree passed; 320 test files passed, 2 skipped; 5,643 tests passed, 3 skipped. Hidden-Unicode, format/lint, typecheck, and full Vitest gates passed. No follow-up issues found.
